title: slopvac v3 plugin manifest
description: The slopvac-plugin.toml file at the root of a plugin. A data plugin holds rules, styles, genres, terms, taggers and prime snippets, and no code. A code plugin adds one [plugin] table with the command to run and the embedded plugin declaration. The manifest of a code plugin is part of the content hash that `slopvac plugins trust` records. Semantics are specified in docs/contract/plugins.md. Owner: slopvac-8l4.2.4.

id.description: Plugin id. It prefixes every rule id the plugin provides. `core` is reserved for the built-in plugin.

slopvac_api.description: Plugin extension API the plugin was written for. A host that implements a lower version refuses the plugin.

kind.description: data: a data plugin, which holds declarative files only and forbids a plugin table. code: a code plugin, which requires the plugin table and runs as a subprocess. Either kind may provide data files.

requires.description: Plugins this plugin needs. The host resolves them before it loads this one.

Semver.description: Semantic version 2.0.0 without build metadata. Numeric prerelease identifiers have no leading zeros.

VersionReq.description: Version requirement: comma-separated comparators, each an optional operator (^ ~ = > >= < <=) and a version with one to three numeric parts. A pre-release suffix is allowed only after a full MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, so 1.0.0-rc.1 is valid and 1.0-rc is not. Numbers have no leading zeros and a pre-release has no empty segment, as in the Semver def. Spaces are allowed after an operator and around a comma, and nowhere else: no leading or trailing space, no newline.

PackPath.description: A path inside the plugin: relative, with forward slashes, and no .. segment. A glob is allowed.

Provides.description: Files the plugin contributes, as paths or globs inside the plugin. Each path holds one artifact of the named kind, and the host validates it against that schema.

configs.description: Config files that a project may extend as <plugin>:<name> (config.schema.json).

prime.description: Markdown snippets that `slopvac prime` appends to a topic.

Plugin.description: How to run the code plugin, plus its pre-spawn declaration. The declaration fields (network, hooks, features) sit flat in this table, so the host reads them from the same bytes that it hashes. See the PluginDeclaration def in plugin-protocol.schema.json. The manifest closes the hook entries and the features table: they take only the declared keys and x- keys, so the hashed bytes carry no unreviewed data.

command.description: Executable inside the plugin, or a bare name that the plugin's own environment provides.

env.description: Names of environment variables the plugin may receive when the user allows them. Nothing else passes through.
